item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence of Sharif personally announcing new cyber, AI, or biological-risk legislation, transparency measures, or crisis-reporting protocols. I also did not find credible 2024 evidence that he handled these domains recklessly or through secrecy. So the best-supported conclusion is that his 2024 record is precautionary by institutional posture, but there is limited direct ruler-level evidence on biological or cyber governance specifically.","evidence":[{"title":"Pakistan-China Bilateral Consultations on Arms Control and Nonproliferation","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Pakistan","date":"2024-09-14","url":"https://mofa.gov.pk/press-releases/pakistan-china-bilateral-consultations-on-arms-control-and-nonproliferation","summary":"Pakistan said the talks covered global/regional security, cyber, AI, outer space, peaceful nuclear technology, and multilateral treaty forums.
